title: 扩唇与改乌唇：轮廓和颜色的区别
intro: 很多人咨询唇部项目时，容易把“想让嘴唇轮廓更饱满清晰”和“想把发乌发暗的唇底提亮”混为一谈。其实扩唇与改乌唇解决的是完全不同的两件事。
intro_en: Many enquiries mix up wanting a clearer lip silhouette with wanting to neutralise dark, cool lip undertones. Contour refinement and dark-lip colour correction tackle two separate issues.

sections.title: 扩唇 / 唇形调整：微调唇峰与边界，不增加实际组织体积
sections.title_en: Lip-contour refinement: subtle edge framing without volume filler
sections.description: 扩唇（唇形调整）主要针对唇形边界模糊、唇峰偏平、上唇略薄或者两侧嘴角视觉略下垂的情况。操作采用电流仪在原生唇缘外侧做非常克制的轮廓与比例微调，让唇峰弧度和上下唇视觉协调度更清楚。必须讲清的边界是：扩唇属于视觉轮廓调整，不会增加真实的唇部组织体积，也不是靠整唇大面积盖浓色来冒充饱满。
sections.description_en: Lip-contour refinement targets blurred borders, flat Cupid’s bows or upper/lower proportion balance using an electric instrument with conservative placement along the natural margin. It refines visual shape and does not add physical tissue volume like injectable fillers.

sections.title: 改乌唇：为什么必须先用暖调互补色乳转色，不能直接拿红色硬盖
sections.title_en: Dark-lip correction: warm complementary neutralisation before soft layering
sections.description: 如果原生唇底色本身发乌、发青紫或局部暗沉不均，直接涂一层正红或粉红重色硬盖上去，底下的深暗色素透出来后，最终反色往往更发暗发浊甚至泛灰紫。描眉画目处理改乌唇的底层逻辑是：先评估乌暗程度与冷暖底调，先用偏暖调的互补色乳（如针对青紫乌调的暖橘/明暖调）把冷暗底色中和转暖，再结合自身皮肤透色情况做轻柔过渡，不追求一次性涂成厚重口红感。
sections.description_en: Applying bright red or pink straight onto naturally dark, cool or uneven lips leaves underlying grey-purple tones showing through, resulting in a muddy healed shade. Proper dark-lip correction first balances cool undertones with warm complementary pigment before layering translucent colour smoothly.

sections.title: 底色越深越要看是否需要分次，以及是否搭配“纹人中窝”
sections.title_en: Staging deep undertones and optional pairing with philtrum shading
sections.description: 轻度唇周暗沉与重度全唇乌暗的转色工作量不一样，是否一次调整还是分次逐步提亮，需要面诊看到素颜自然光下的真实唇色后再决定，不保证单次一定达到某一种指定口红色号。此外，如果本身不仅想微调唇峰，还觉得中庭略偏长，面诊时也可以同步评估“扩唇 + 纹人中窝”的光影配合。
sections.description_en: Mild dullness along the border differs from deep all-over dark undertones, so whether staging is sensible must be judged in natural light rather than promising an exact lipstick shade in one session. Clients wanting subtle mid-face proportion balance can also explore philtrum shading alongside contour work.

sections.title: 恢复期区分：两类都有结痂期，但时间参考不同
sections.title_en: Different healing timelines: both involve scabbing, not the same day count
sections.description: 扩唇和改乌唇都不属于“无尴尬期、当天随便碰水”的品类，两者在恢复过程中都会经历结痂期：扩唇的门店经验恢复期参考约3天；改乌唇由于每个人的底色深度和皮肤更新节奏差异很大，不预设统一恢复天数，需要现场说明护理。两类项目均享有一年内免费补色，具体复看时机按各自返色稳态安排。
sections.description_en: Unlike instrument brow work, both lip services involve a scabbing phase. Contour refinement typically uses around three days as an experience guide, whereas dark-lip correction is never assigned a single universal day count due to wide individual variation. Both include free touch-ups within one year.
